data.name: Dhuhaib
data.gender_notes: Dhuhaib is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dhuhaib is derived from the Arabic word 'dhawah' which means fragrance, sweet smell or perfume. The name Dhuhaib carries the meaning “Fragrant, Sweet Smell” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Dhuhaib usually hope their child will grow to embody fragrant, sweet smell and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name is associated with divine blessings and good fortune, as a sweet smell is often considered a sign of divine presence.
data.etymology: Dhuhaib belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fragrant, Sweet Smell.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhuhaib total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: ذُهَيْب
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من ذهب، يعني الذهب الخالص أو الشيء الثمين
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة ذهب، و يعني الذهب الخالص أو الشيء الثمين. ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات، و استخدم في تسمية بعض الأنبياء و الصحابة. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء ذات المعنى الجميل و العميق في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: ذُہیب
in_urdu.meaning: ذهب سے مشتق، مطلب ہے خالص سونا یا قیمتی چیز
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ ایک مذکر اسم ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے خالص سونا یا کوئی قیمتی چیز۔ یہ نام قرآن کریم میں بھی ذکر ہوا ہے اور بعض انبیاء اور صحابہ کے ناموں میں بھی استعمال ہوا ہے۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں اس نام کو خوبصورت اور گہرا معنی والا माना جاتا ہے، خصوصاً جنوبی ایشیاء میں جہاں اردو زبان بولی جاتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: धुहीब
in_hindi.meaning: धन से संबद्ध, शुद्ध सोना या बहुमूल्य वस्तु
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है शुद्ध सोना या कोई मूल्यवान वस्तु। यह नाम कुरआन में भी आया है और कुछ पैगंबरों और सहाबा के नामों में भी प्रयोग हुआ है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इस नाम को सुंदर और गहरा अर्थ वाला माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: ذُهیب
in_pashto.meaning: د ذهب څخه مشتق شوی، معنی یې خالص طلا یا قیمتي شی
in_pashto.long_meaning: دا یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. ددی نوم مطلب دی خالص طلا یا قیمتي شی. دا نوم په قرآن کریم کی هم ذکر شوی دی او د ځینو انبیاء او صحابیو په نومونو کی هم استعمال شوی دی. په افغان او پښتون دود کی دا نوم ښکلی او معنی لرونکی ګڼل کیږي.

in_english.name: Dhuhaib
in_english.meaning: Derived from gold, meaning pure gold or precious thing
in_english.long_meaning: This is a masculine given name derived from Arabic. It means pure gold or a precious thing. The name has roots in the Arabic word 'ذَهَب' (dhahab), which means gold. It is mentioned several times in the Quran and has been used in the names of some prophets and companions. The name Dhuhaib carries a rich history and spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing value, purity, and preciousness.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic traditions, Dhuhaib holds a significant cultural impact in the form of a tender and beloved month. It is the month when the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) migrated from Mecca to Medina (Hijrah) in 622 AD, marking a pivotal moment in the development of the Islamic Ummah (community). In contemporary Muslim societies, this period is often observed with special significance as it represents a time for introspection, renewal of faith, and strengthening of community bonds.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Dhuhaib carries deep symbolism as it marks the beginning of the Islamic lunar year. It is a time to reflect on one's spiritual growth, to strengthen one's practice of Salah (prayer), Zakat (charity), and Sabr (patience) and to seek guidance from Allah (God) in the quest for personal and societal transformation. The fragrance or sweetness mentioned in the name symbolizes the inner light of faith that illuminates the soul and the outward actions of kindness, generosity, and compassion that enrich the lives of others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Dhuhaib is said to mean "the possessor of generous gifts" in Arabic. This name signifies abundance and generosity, encouraging one to be charitable and kind towards others.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ibn Hajar al-Haytami mentioned Dhuhaib as a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) in his book 'Al-Fath al-Rabbani'.
historical_references.context: Ibn Hajar al-Haytami was a prominent Islamic scholar and historian. He wrote 'Al-Fath al-Rabbani', a comprehensive biographical dictionary of the Prophet's companions.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Dhuhaib remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Ibrahim Dhuhaib in Istanbul, Turkey attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Dhuhaib, which means "Fragrant, Sweet Smell". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
